description: Returns the published comparison between Modulos and one other vendor: a row per dimension (frameworks, risk quantification, deployment, certifications, pricing and more) with the statement for each side, and the cases in which each vendor is the better choice. The comparison is written by Modulos; the page lists its sources.

competitor.description: Vendor slug as returned by list_competitors, for example "credo-ai".

name: compare_with
